{{recipesummary|category=Meat recipes|servings=6|time=50 minutes|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat Recipes|Meat Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|United States]]

'''Spicy chicken casserole''' isn't that spicy unless you make it that way. In fact, change the ingredients to suit your own taste and it will probably taste better.

==Ingredients==
*1 can (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]])  [[Cookbook:Chili|chili]]
*1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup
*1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of celery soup
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], shredded
*1½ cups [[Cookbook:Salsa|salsa]]
*1 package [[Cookbook:Tortilla|corn tortilla]]s
*8 oz [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]], shredded

==Procedure==
#Mix all ingredients except tortillas and cheese.
#Layer the tortillas, chicken mixture, and cheese in [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. Make two layers, finishing with cheese.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|375°F]] for 30–40 minutes.
